📺 This Fool (2022–2023)

This Fool follows Julio Lopez, a kindhearted but socially awkward 30-year-old man living in South Central Los Angeles who spends most of his time helping others while struggling to improve his own life. Working at a nonprofit organization that helps former gang members rebuild their futures, Julio finds himself constantly dealing with ridiculous situations, complicated family relationships, and unexpected challenges. Things become even more chaotic when his older cousin Luis is released from prison and begins adjusting to life outside. As the two navigate their differences, their hilarious arguments and unusual adventures reveal the importance of family, friendship, and personal growth. Inspired by comedian Chris Estrada’s experiences, This Fool combines sharp humor, relatable struggles, and heartfelt storytelling about second chances and finding your place in the world.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 7.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 25–30 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creators: Chris Estrada, Pat Bishop, Jake Weisman & Matt Ingebretson

📺 Where to Watch: Hulu in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: This Fool is an American comedy television series created by Chris Estrada, Pat Bishop, Matt Ingebretson, and Jake Weisman, and starring Estrada and Frankie Quiñones. It premiered on Hulu on August 12, 2022, and concluded on July 28, 2023. The show includes a comedic look at cholo culture and lifestyle. In November 2022, the series was renewed for a second season. In February 2024, the series was canceled after two seasons.
